title: Avengers: Doctor Destiny hits Brazil with early pre‑sale
seoTitle: Avengers: Doctor Destiny hits Brazil with early pre‑sale
subtitle: Tickets for Infinity Vision auditoriums go on sale at midnight and the film premieres in December 2026
excerpt: Disney announced the pre‑sale start for Avengers: Doctor Destiny, beginning at 00:01 on September 28 (Brasília time) for Infinity Vision screens.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Super‑hero fans are waiting for the pre‑sale tickets to open for Avengers: Doctor Destiny, the next chapter of the Marvel Cinematic Universe saga. The date was released by Disney and is set for the early hours of September 28, Brasília time.

Pre‑sale date and format

Tickets will be available from September 28 at 00:01, exclusively for sessions in Infinity Vision‑branded auditoriums. Purchases will be made through the Ingresso.com website and apps, allowing viewers to secure the best seats for the first showings.

Confirmed cast and characters

The film brings together a broad cast of familiar faces. Robert Downey Jr. plays the villain Victor Von Doom, Doctor Destiny. Among the heroes, Chris Evans returns as Captain America, Chris Hemsworth as Thor, Sebastian Stan as Winter Soldier, Anthony Mackie as Falcon, Paul Rudd as Ant‑Man, Winston Duke and Letitia Wright as Black Panther, Simu Liu as Shang‑Chi and Danny Ramirez.

Members of the Fantastic Four are also confirmed – Pedro Pascal, Vanessa Kirby, Joseph Quinn and Ebon Moss‑Bachrach – as are the Thunderbolts, featuring Florence Pugh, Wyatt Russell, David Harbour, Hannah John‑Kamen and Lewis Pullman. The X‑Men appear again, represented by Patrick Stewart, Ian McKellen, James Marsden, Kelsey Grammer, Rebecca Romijn, Alan Cumming and Channing Tatum.

Plot and multiverse threats

In the story, heroes from three distinct universes collide as the multiverse saga enters its final chapter. The villain Doctor Destiny triggers a multiversal collapse caused by incursions, when universes clash with each other. This crisis threatens the existence of all realities.

New visual clues: the Latvéria witches

A new poster shows Doctor Destiny surrounded by three Latvéria witches dressed in purple, red and green. The most common reading links the colors to characters such as Clea (purple), Wanda Maximoff – the Scarlet Witch – (red) and Sylvie, a Loki variant (green). The studio has not yet confirmed the witches' identities, but the material reinforces the presence of magic and new allies for the villain.

Direction and production

The film is directed by brothers Joe and Anthony Russo, veterans of the franchise. The screenplay is written by Michael Waldron, creator of Loki, and Stephen McFeely, known for Agent Carter. Marvel producer Kevin Feige highlighted his fascination with the Doctor Destiny character during the promotional campaign.

The official premiere of Avengers: Doctor Destiny is set for December 17, 2026. While the pre‑sale date for traditional circuit theatres has not yet been announced, fans can follow updates via Ingresso.com’s WhatsApp channel.

With information from Ingresso.com, Estadão, einerd.com.
